title: Checkout stepper
brief: A three step progress row: Cart is done with a tick, Delivery is current, Payment is next and reacts to hover and focus. Connectors join the circles.

inspiration.note: Took the done, current and upcoming step states joined by a line; ours uses filled circles, a drawn tick and a dashed connector for the upcoming part.
Took the labels under the circles; palette and sizes are ours.
